workflows.name: automated_template_gating
workflows.intent: Perform automated hierarchical gating on raw FCS files using a predefined CSV gating template.
input: gtFile (CSV gating template defining the hierarchical gating scheme)
workflows.stages:
1. Load raw FCS files into a cytoset and initialize a GatingSet.
2. Apply compensation using a compensation matrix.
3. Transform the stained channels (e.g., using estimateLogicle).
4. Load the gating template from the CSV file.
5. Apply the gating template to the GatingSet using gt_gating.
6. Hide intermediate or auxiliary gating nodes and rename populations for clean visualization.
7. Plot the gating hierarchy and visualize the gates.
workflows.code:
fcsFiles <- list.files(pattern = "CytoTrol", flowDataPath, full = TRUE)
cs  <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcsFiles)
cf <- realize_view(cs[[1]])
gs <- GatingSet(cs)
compMat <- gh_get_compensations(gh)
compensate(gs, compMat)
chnls <- parameters(compMat)
trans <- estimateLogicle(gs[[1]], channels = chnls)
gs <- transform(gs, trans)
gt_tcell <- gatingTemplate(gtFile)
gt_gating(gt_tcell, gs)
lapply(nodesToHide, function(thisNode) gs_pop_set_visibility(gs, thisNode, FALSE))
gs_pop_set_name(gs, "cd4+cd8-", "cd4")
gs_pop_set_name(gs, "cd4-cd8+", "cd8")
plot(gs[[1]])
autoplot(gs[[1]])

workflows.name: interactive_gating_prototyping
workflows.intent: Interactively prototype and test individual gating methods on a GatingSet without writing a complete CSV template.
input: gs (a pre-loaded, compensated, and transformed GatingSet object)
workflows.stages:
1. Add a new population using gs_add_gating_method by specifying gating parameters directly.
2. Visualize the updated gating tree to inspect the results.
3. Remove the last added population using gs_remove_gating_method if adjustments are needed.
workflows.code:
gs_add_gating_method(gs, alias = "non-activated cd4",
                         pop = "--",
                         parent = "cd4",
                         dims = "CD38,HLA",
                         gating_method = "mindensity")
plot(gs[[1]])
gs_remove_gating_method(gs)
plot(gs[[1]])
